steps.en: Processing stage condition is applied to listed summonses
steps.id: Syarat processing stage diterapkan pada summons yang ditampilkan
steps.why_en: Stage is only a manual filter, with no eligibility rule for witness applications.
steps.why_id: Stage hanya filter manual, tanpa aturan kelayakan permohonan witness.

steps.id: Hanya summons yang masih outstanding yang ditampilkan
steps.why_en: An outstanding-notices search exists but is not an automatic rule for witness applications.
steps.why_id: Ada pencarian notice outstanding, tapi bukan aturan otomatis untuk permohonan witness.

steps.why_en: Offence columns exist only in a generic notice list.
steps.why_id: Kolom offence hanya ada di daftar notice umum.

steps.en: Latest court mention date is displayed
steps.why_en: A court date column exists, but it is not confirmed to be the latest mention date.
steps.why_id: Ada kolom tanggal court, tapi belum terbukti tanggal mention terbaru.

steps.id: Hanya summons yang memenuhi syarat yang ditampilkan
steps.why_en: No eligibility rule for witness applications exists.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada aturan kelayakan untuk permohonan witness.
